errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the region names to the data. The chart's first group, labeled "Северозап...", has values 192, 444, and 648. However, the description assigns these values to the region name "Северозападен". The second group, labeled "Северен...", has values 89, 436, and 627, which the description assigns to the region name "Северен". Based on the full names of the Bulgarian regions, "Северозап..." is Северозападен (Northwestern) and "Северен..." is Северен централен (North Central). Thus, the description swaps the data between the two regions.

errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the regions on the x-axis are sorted in alphabetical order. The order on the chart is: "Северозап...", "Северен...", "Североизт...", "Югоизточе...", "Югозападе...", "Южен...", which is not alphabetical.
The description reports a value of 663 for the electrified lines in the Southwestern region, but the value shown on the chart is 660.
The description does not mention the title of the chart, "Дял на електрифицираните и двойните жп линии" (Share of electrified and double railway lines).
